title: Tab asked for, no strings declared — nothing is assumed
description: The part sets tab.staffKind: "both" but declares no strings[]. Since the instrument-neutrality change, no consumer assumes a tuning: the tab staff renders bare (lines, clef, time signature — no fret digits, because no fingerboard exists to derive against) and a red scope:'tab' badge reports the inconsistency — declare strings, or supply an instrument from the viewer. Pins the retraction of the old "absent ⇒ standard guitar" default: this render breaking silent-guitar assumptions is the point.
